trust_decision.summary: Whether a .pt file read by experimental PyTorchDataset.load() is deserialised with the restricted unpickler (weights_only=True) or full pickle; decided only by the kwargs given to torch.load in PyTorchDataset.load, where at the pinned commit no weights_only is set (left to the installed torch default) and fs open_args_load are passed in instead of load_args.

landing_point.why: The summary names PyTorchDataset and torch.load; this is the only torch.load call in the tree.

fix_sites.entry_point: PyTorchDataset(...) constructor / catalog YAML `type: pytorch.PyTorchDataset` (default load_args merged at :86-88)
PyTorchDataset.load() (public API, reached by DataCatalog load)
PyTorchDataset(...) fs_args.open_args_load / open_args_save handling (fix adds binary-mode defaults, fix.diff:109-110)
PyTorchDataset.save() (save_args now forwarded, fix.diff:128-129); not security-relevant

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: kedro-datasets/kedro_datasets_experimental/pytorch/pytorch_dataset.py:50 (DEFAULT_LOAD_ARGS, merged at :86-88) and :65/:93/:107 (fs_args.open_args_load flows into torch.load kwargs); same file as the landing point, so it doesn't look out of scope

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: torch>=2.6 already defaults weights_only=True, so a solver can argue the default is safe and that fs_args.open_args_load is a file-open option, not a deserialisation option, so it's out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Round-tripping a state_dict must keep working, and the documented opt-out load_args {weights_only: false} for trusted files must reach torch.load (fix.diff:150-160). Hard-coding weights_only=True or rejecting all load_args breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: user load_args overriding weights_only (must be forwarded, not dropped)
fs_args.open_args_load (must go to fs.open, no longer to torch.load)
local and fsspec-remote filepaths (fix opens via self._fs.open, fix.diff:119)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A torch-checkpoint load branch (for example `load_method: load_state_dict`) that calls torch.load directly on the file without weights_only
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This dataset already dispatches on several torch-based load methods (:153-178), so a direct torch.load branch fits the existing structure. It sits in another package from the pytorch dataset.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second loader in the same dataset (for example a versioned or `load_full_model` path) that uses torch.load with its own kwargs dict
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers often add full-module loading next to state_dict loading. It would be a where-type sibling and is likely to be fixed together with the main one.

O9_family: CWE-502 unsafe deserialisation (pickle via torch.load without weights_only)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/uv install of kedro-datasets with extra `pytorch-dataset` (torch, unpinned: kedro-datasets/pyproject.toml:245) plus pytest and pytest-mock

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add weights_only=True as a literal to the torch.load call at :107, which keeps passing open_args_load and still drops user load_args.

out_of_scope_notes: kedro-datasets/kedro_datasets_experimental/darts/darts_torch_model_dataset.py:155 passes load_args to darts' own model.load (a third-party deserialiser); this is a different sink and was not pursued.
kedro-datasets/kedro_datasets_experimental/mlrun/model.py:88 calls joblib.load on an MLRun artifact (pickle by design); this is a different sink.
kedro-datasets/kedro_datasets/pickle/pickle_dataset.py and kedro-datasets/kedro_datasets/redis/redis_dataset.py:165 are pickle by design; out of scope.
Stale 'avoid security issues with Pickle' claims remain at kedro-datasets/docs/api/kedro_datasets_experimental/index.md:27 and kedro-datasets/RELEASE.md:361; these are docs only.

Not checked against the installed torch.
Whether darts' TorchForecastingModel.load uses unrestricted pickle; the darts source is not in this tree.
